children.title: Investor Presentation
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Investor Presentation
children.summary: This section serves as the title page and disclaimer for NVIDIA's Investor Presentation for Q1 FY27, dated May 2026. It includes a forward-looking statements warning referencing the Securities Act of 1933 and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, outlines important factors that could cause actual results to differ from expectations (such as global economic conditions and technological developments), clarifies product availability terms, and explains the use of non-GAAP financial measures.

children.title: Revenue
children.summary: This page presents a financial overview of NVIDIA's revenue growth, comparing Q1 FY26 ($44.1B) to Q1 FY27 ($81.6B). The slide highlights key drivers including strong adoption of Blackwell architecture across hyperscalers and cloud providers, new opportunities in Agentic AI, the upcoming Vera Rubin platform, and superior performance metrics from MLPerf benchmarks.

children.title: Data Center
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Data Center
children.summary: This page displays a bar chart illustrating Data Center revenue in billions of dollars, comparing performance between Q1 FY26 and Q1 FY27. The data is segmented into two sub-markets: Hyperscale and AI Clouds, Industrial, and Enterprise (ACIE). Both segments show significant growth, with Hyperscale rising from $17.6B to $37.9B and ACIE increasing from $21.5B to $37.4B. A note at the bottom attributes this growth to continued strong demand for the Blackwell architecture.

children.title: Gross Margin
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Gross Margin
children.summary: The page displays a bar chart titled 'Gross Margin' comparing GAAP and Non-GAAP metrics for Q1 FY26 and Q1 FY27. The chart shows a significant increase in gross margin from 60.5% to 74.9% for GAAP and from 60.8% to 75.0% for Non-GAAP. A note at the bottom explains that this year-on-year increase is driven by lower inventory provisions, specifically due to a $4.5B charge associated with H20 excess inventory in the prior year.

children.title: Operating Expenses
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Operating Expenses
children.summary: The page displays a bar chart titled 'Operating Expenses' showing financial data in billions of dollars. It compares GAAP and Non-GAAP expenses for Q1 FY26 and Q1 FY27, highlighting an increase from $5.0B to $7.6B (GAAP) and $5.0B to $7.4B (Non-GAAP). The footer text states the company is investing to address growth opportunities.

children.title: Earnings per Share
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Earnings per Share
children.summary: The page displays a bar chart titled 'Earnings per Share' comparing GAAP and Non-GAAP figures for Q1 FY26 and Q1 FY27. The GAAP section shows an increase from $0.76 in Q1 FY26 to $2.39 in Q1 FY27, while the Non-GAAP section rises from $0.78 to $1.87 over the same period. A caption at the bottom notes that top-line growth and operating leverage drove this accelerating EPS growth.

children.title: Free Cash Flow and Capital Return
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Free Cash Flow and Capital Return
children.summary: This page displays a financial chart titled 'Free Cash Flow and Capital Return' with values in billions of dollars. It compares data for Q1 FY26 and Q1 FY27, showing Free Cash Flow increasing from $26.1B to $48.6B. The Capital Return section breaks down shareholder returns into Dividends (~$14.0B) and Share Repurchases (~$20.0B) for the respective periods. A text box at the bottom notes a record ~$20B return to shareholders, a new $80B share repurchase authorization, and an increased quarterly dividend.

children.title: GAAP P&L Financial Measures
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/GAAP P&L Financial Measures
children.summary: The page displays a table titled 'GAAP P&L Financial Measures' presenting financial data for Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26. The table includes key metrics such as Revenue, Gross Margin %, Operating Expenses, Operating Income, Net Income, and Diluted EPS, with values expressed in billions of dollars (except EPS) and year-over-year percentage changes.

children.title: Non-GAAP P&L Financial Measures
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Non-GAAP P&L Financial Measures
children.summary: The page displays a table titled 'Non-GAAP P&L Financial Measures' presenting financial data in billions of dollars, excluding EPS. The table compares metrics for Q1 FY27 against Q1 FY26 and includes the Year-over-Year (YoY) percentage change. Key rows include Revenue, Gross Margin %, Operating Expenses, Operating Income, Net Income, and Diluted EPS.

children.title: Q2 FY27 Outlook – Non-GAAP
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Q2 FY27 Outlook – Non-GAAP
children.summary: This page presents the Q2 FY27 Non-GAAP financial outlook, featuring a table with key metrics including Revenue ($91.0 billion), Gross Margin % (75.0%), and Operating Expenses ($8.3 billion). A note below specifies that for the full fiscal year 2027, non-GAAP tax rates are expected to be between 16.0% and 18.0%. A footnote clarifies that the revenue outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China.

children.title: Reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP Financial Measures
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP Financial Measures
children.summary: The section titled 'Reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP Financial Measures' presents two detailed tables comparing financial metrics for Q1 FY27 and Q1 FY26. The tables reconcile Non-GAAP figures to GAAP figures by accounting for adjustments related to acquisition costs, other items (such as legal settlements and equity securities), and tax impacts. Key metrics reconciled include gross margin, operating expense, operating income, net income, diluted shares, and diluted EPS.

children.title: Reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP Financial Measures (contd.)
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Quarterly Presentation.pdf/Root/Reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP Financial Measures (contd.)
children.summary: This section presents a reconciliation of Non-GAAP to GAAP financial measures for NVIDIA. The first table details the Q2 FY27 outlook, reconciling Non-GAAP gross margin (75.0%) and operating expenses ($8,300 million) to their GAAP equivalents by accounting for acquisition-related costs. The second table compares cash flow metrics between Q1 FY2027 and Q1 FY2026, specifically showing Free Cash Flow, purchases related to property and equipment, principal payments on such assets, and net cash provided by operating activities.
